name: Hot-Foot (Half-Giant)
body:
–

Benefit: Your Fire-based powers give your enemies a “hot-foot”. Any creature that takes damage from a fire-based power you manifest takes 1 point of fire damage on their next turn.

Special: Only Half-Giants may take this Racial trait.
